Problems with credentials for HTTP Request on self hosted N8N
Im trying to do a firecrawl request via http Node in self hosted n8n (hostinger) and im running into an issue. Whenever I setup the credential and reload the page or actually test the flow it unplugs that credential again saying I have no credentials set up. When I setup a new credential suddenly the others that I setup are available. Whats going on here anyone can help?

Scott Jessen
• 7d
@Jonas Hermann It sounds like your encryption key isn't holding between restarts. I would check that `N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY` is set as a static env variable in your config, if it's not set, n8n generates a random one each boot and can't decrypt the credentials it saved previously.
